prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person in a pink and green sequined leotard with floral patterns and matching leg coverings"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P04","P05"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"All five individuals wear identical pink and green sequined leotards with floral patterns and matching leg coverings. The attire is consistent across all tiles, with no visible differences in design or color scheme. The phrase describes the outfit accurately for every person shown."}
